summary: CC's parse_one_local_decl called add_local (which sizes and allocates the stack slot) before parsing the initializer, so an unsized local array like is_type_start's `const char *kws[] = {...}` got a zero-size slot whose initialization clobbered the frame; Stage2 CC segfaulted on any program containing a local declaration.

DBG: kws array built, kws[0]=void
DBG: i=0 kws[i]=void
exit=139

summary: CC compiled pointer-minus-pointer (elf_writer.c's `s - ctx->syms`) as pointer arithmetic (result typed as pointer, scaled by multiply) instead of an integer element count, corrupting the relocation symbol index and making Stage2 AS segfault on any input with a relocation.
evidence:

DBG: found sym, computing symidx

summary: LD's chmod(path, 0755) was read by CC as decimal 755 (CC's lexer has no octal literals), so Stage2-linked executables got nonsense permissions (octal 1363, -wxrw--wt).

CC's parse_struct_members had its own multi-dimensional array loop that nested array types in the wrong order (the bug already fixed in parse_declarator), so AS's 2-D struct member section buffers were mislaid and Stage2 AS wrote .data bytes into the .text section, producing crashing binaries (t11/t12).
evidence: Found it — `parse_struct_members` has its own unfixed multi-dimensional array parsing loop (the same bug I fixed earlier in `parse_declarator`, but never applied here).

summary: CC did not support `char x[N] = "literal"` (unbraced string init of a char array) for globals or locals; codegen's local `char default_label[MAX_NAME] = ""` left garbage, so Stage2 CC emitted `jmp Z` for a switch default.
evidence: as: relocation against unknown symbol 'Z' ... char default_label[MAX_NAME] = "";

summary: The Makefile's toolchain rule still used the old plain-gcc bootstrap instead of the new 3-stage bootstrap_selfhost.sh, so `make` did not build the OS with the verified self-hosted toolchain.
evidence: The OS build used the old plain-gcc bootstrap rule, not the new 3-stage self-hosting script.

summary: AS's .dq directive computed the high dword with `v >> 32`, a no-op under x86 shift-count masking once int64_t is CC's 32-bit alias, so self-hosted AS corrupted boot.S's DAP LBA field and the OS never got past the boot sector.
evidence: run_tests: FAIL - timed out waiting for 'SELFTEST PASS' ... boot.bin: DIFFERS ... 77   0   1 ... dq 1 ; starting LBA
